    return df

    X_eng = engineer_features(X)

        l2_leaf_reg=3,

        random_seed=seed,
        verbose=False,
        subsample=0.9,
        rsm=0.9
    )
    cb.fit(X_base, y_base)
    base_models.append(('catboost', cb))
    # LightGBM
    lgb = LGBMClassifier(
        n_estimators=1000,
        learning_rate=0.01,
        max_depth=8,
        subsample=0.9,
        colsample_bytree=0.9,
        random_state=seed+1,
        n_jobs=-1
    )
    lgb.fit(X_base, y_base)
    base_models.append(('lgbm', lgb))
    # XGBoost
    xgb = XGBClassifier(
        n_estimators=1000,
        learning_rate=0.01,
        max_depth=8,
        subsample=0.9,
        colsample_bytree=0.9,
        random_state=seed+2,
        n_jobs=-1
    )
    xgb.fit(X_base, y_base)
    base_models.append(('xgb', xgb))

        else:
            holdout_preds.append(m.predict_proba(X_holdout)[:, 1])
    X_holdout_meta = np.column_stack(holdout_preds)  # shape (n_holdout, 3)
    # Train meta-learner
    meta_model = LogisticRegression(random_state=seed)
    meta_model.fit(X_holdout_meta, y_holdout)
    # Refit base models on full training data

            m.fit(X, y)
        elif name == 'lgbm':
            m.fit(X, y)
        else:
            m.fit(X, y)

        else:
            base_preds.append(m.predict_proba(X)[:, 1])

    )
